kultivator.hidup.keadaan.sakit.0: Cough... forgive me, sir. I have been feverish for three days.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.sakit.1: The healer says I must drink a bitter brew every morning. Bitter beyond words.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.sakit.2: If you pass the medicine shop, please ask the price of red ginseng for me.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.sakit.3: Do not come too close, you might catch it. I even sent the children to sleep at their grandmother's.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.mabuk.0: Hic! Sir... my friend! One more cup, I pay... tomorrow.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.mabuk.1: Two moons... eh, one. It was two. Hahaha!
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.mabuk.2: My wife will be angry... let her, tonight I am the king of this tavern!
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.mabuk.3: Listen, listen, I know the boat song from the south... laaa...
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pengantin.0: We married only yesterday! Thank you for your greeting, sir.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pengantin.1: The whole town came to our feast. My feet still ache from dancing.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pengantin.2: My mother-in-law is already asking for a grandchild. It has been one day!
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pengantin.3: This red flower is from the feast. They say it brings a hundred years of fortune.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.berkabung.0: Our house is still in mourning. Forgive me if I do not say much.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.berkabung.1: I am back at work. They would not have liked to see me sitting idle.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.berkabung.2: Every dusk I burn incense at the altar. The smoke rises so slowly.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.berkabung.3: I wear white until the seventh day. That is the custom of our family.
